description: Versioned schema for the NNTune v2 KV config namespaces (staging/prod). Every key carries its type, default, and env-overridability. Secret values are never declared here: Worker secrets and rotation live outside KV config. Workers read these keys only through the typed accessor (crates/nntune-config); see config/README.md for the adding-a-key procedure.

auth.challenge_ttl_secs.description: Passkey challenge lifetime in seconds (workers/api auth).

auth.invite_redemption_max_attempts.description: Max verification attempts inside one invite redemption window.

auth.invite_redemption_window_secs.description: Invite redemption attempt window in seconds.

auth.rp_id.description: Passkey relying-party id (hostname). Per-environment, so it has no default.

auth.rp_origin.description: Passkey relying-party origin URL. Per-environment, so it has no default.

ingest.max_nzb_bytes.description: Max accepted NZB upload body in bytes (2 MiB).

ingest.payload_retry_attempts.description: Queue-consumer payload-fetch retry attempts; must cover the KV read-lag window.

ingest.payload_ttl_secs.description: Payload KV time-to-live in seconds (30 days).

mb.lookup_cache_ttl_s.description: MusicBrainz lookup success-cache TTL in seconds (immutable-ish rows).

mb.max_query_chars.description: Upper bound on search query length in chars; bounds trigram work and KV keys.

mb.search_cache_ttl_s.description: MusicBrainz search success-cache TTL in seconds.

mb.search_limit.description: Max search hits returned (SQL LIMIT and defensive truncation).

session.ttl_secs.description: Session cookie lifetime in seconds. The effective lifetime is min(config, the one-day authentication cap in workers/api session).

stream.r2_min_part_bytes.description: Minimum R2 multipart part size in bytes (5 MiB).

vault.indexer_allow_redirects.description: Whether BYO indexer probe requests follow HTTP redirects. Fail-closed default.
